2610.02741.title: On the Chain-of-Thought Monitorability of Looped Language Models
2610.02741.paper_summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) monitoring provides a promising approach for detecting undesirable model behavior. Looped language models (LoopLMs) repeatedly apply shared transformer layers, increasing effective computational depth and enabling additional latent computation without increasing model size. However, the effect of looped architectures on CoT monitorability remains largely unexplored. In this work, we provide the first systematic evaluation of CoT monitorability in LoopLMs. We study two complementary settings: (1) varying the loop depth within the same LoopLM family to isolate the effect of additional recurrent computation, and (2) comparing LoopLMs with non-looped language models matched by parameter size, transformer-layer count, or effective depth to study whether LoopLMs are less monitorable. Across eight tasks from MonitorBench and both standard and stress-test settings, we observe task-dependent reductions in CoT monitorability under stress tests on specific Logic/Science/Engineering \texttt{Cue Answer} tasks, while other tasks exhibit weaker or qualitatively different trends. Our diagnosis suggests that these declines are not fully explained by task difficulty, verification pass rate, or generated token length; qualitative examples further suggest changes in how deeper-loop models explicitly use or attribute provided cues. Our cross-model comparison finds no evidence that LoopLMs are systematically less monitorable than non-looped language models matched on size or depth. Overall, our results suggest that deeper loop depth can reduce CoT monitorability in some tasks under stress tests, but looped transformer architecture alone does not necessarily imply lower monitorability.
2610.02741.paper_summary_zh: Chain-of-thought (CoT) 監控提供了一種有前景的方法來檢測不良的模型行為。<lb/>循環語言模型 (LoopLMs) 重複應用共享的Transformer層，增加了有效的計算深度，並在不增加模型大小的情況下啟用額外的潛在計算。<lb/>然而，循環架構對 CoT 監控能力的影響仍然在很大程度上未被探索。<lb/>在本研究中，我們提供了對 LoopLMs 中 CoT 監控能力的首次系統評估。<lb/>我們研究了兩個互補的設定：(1) 在同一 LoopLM 家族中變化循環深度，以孤立額外遞歸計算的影響，以及 (2) 比較與參數大小、Transformer層數或有效深度匹配的非循環語言模型，以研究 LoopLMs 是否較不易監控。<lb/>在來自 MonitorBench 的八個任務以及標準和壓力測試設定中，我們觀察到在特定的邏輯/科學/工程 \texttt{Cue Answer} 任務上，CoT 監控能力在壓力測試下呈現依賴於任務的減少，而其他任務則表現出較弱或質量不同的趨勢。<lb/>我們的診斷表明，這些下降並不能完全用任務難度、驗證通過率或生成的標記長度來解釋；質性例子進一步表明，較深循環模型在如何明確使用或歸因提供的提示方面發生了變化。<lb/>我們的跨模型比較沒有發現 LoopLMs 系統性地比與大小或深度匹配的非循環語言模型更不易監控的證據。<lb/>總體而言，我們的結果表明，在某些任務的壓力測試下，較深的循環深度可能會降低 CoT 監控能力，但僅僅是循環Transformer架構並不一定意味著較低的監控能力。
